title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
summary: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
summary: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
summary: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
summary: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
summary: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.
